title: rpt plugin record
description: One plugin found by rpt plugins. Every member but kind, name and path comes from the plugin's --describe answer, unknown ones included, and is absent when it gave none in time.

name.description: The verb: the file name without its rpt- prefix.

path.description: Absolute path of the program rpt <name> runs.

description.description: What a plugin prints for --describe: one JSON object on one line, then exit 0.

summary.description: One line: what the plugin does.

usage.description: One line, e.g. rpt parse-nuclei < results.jsonl.

input.description: The data the plugin takes. Absent: not said.

output.description: The data the plugin gives. Absent: not said.

dataType.description: records for an rpt JSON Lines stream; otherwise <format> or <format>/<tool>, lowercase, chosen by the plugin author, e.g. xml/nessus, jsonl/nuclei, pdf.
